Context only: not a risk signal and not part of any score. Bunching below a threshold is a description of the budget distribution; it can come from contract splitting or from real purchasing distortion, and neither is identified here. The counterfactual is a fitted polynomial; round-number budgets and the shape of demand can move it.

data_notes: The amount that decides the procedure is the budget (presupuesto referencial), which the lake has for 100 % of competitive processes; award amounts are a secondary view.
Ínfima cuantía procedures are not in the lake (no such method; competitive budgets start above it), so the lowest threshold cannot be analysed for bunching, only counted just above.
From the 2025 reform the thresholds are fixed at USD 10,000 and the procedures below (ínfima cuantía) are absent from the lake: 2026 cannot be analysed for bunching.
